product_constraint: Finish bounded sustained-service validation for both sealed v122 draft caps while preserving exact output, capacity, reserve and the outstanding cap2 short >=1.5x performance requirement.
scope: One fresh process per cap, serialized cap2 then cap3; exact frozen capacity-qualified binaries. No repeated capacity/capability panel. This is reliability evidence, not final performance selection or production promotion.
gates: Fresh existing Jetson preflight and successful cache preparation; no foreign GPU ownership, >90C operational stop; sanitize incidental fan fields.
Complete historical native request/text/usage/finish/DONE match every request; full output token IDs equal first MTP request on every reuse. Native historical IDs absent.
Audit complete route/resource/physical-work receipt for every request; report paired Prefill/TTFT/Decode/total, not a speed selection.
Record GPU clocks during sustained requests, bounded resource plateau after warmup, health, normal shutdown and key removal.
Fresh restart after each completed soak checks same response and token IDs; no reliability pass before restart.
implementation: Extend existing MTP validation driver with explicit sustained-only mode; host negative tests for response drift, token drift, insufficient reuse and resource growth. Reuse process cleanup and telemetry.
stop: Actual failure retains partial evidence and selects one explicit repair; no blind reruns or runtime optimization during GPU measurement.
remaining: Cap2 short speed implementation and final repeated selection/installation remain open; ordinary nonMTP unchanged.
host_validation: 18 unit tests pass (sustained negative controls, capability and document control); no real-model sustained pass claimed.
